a.style: font-family:'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: Annual population change determined by births and deaths. Migration is not included. In this future scenario,
net migration is set to zero from 2024 onwards, while mortality and fertility assumptions follow the UN's
medium scenario; this means feedback between migration and these factors are not incorporated.
Data source: UN, World Population Prospects (2024)
